mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date_label, COUNT(user_id) AS signup_count FROM users WHERE created_at BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY date_label ORDER BY date_label ASC

SELECT CONCAT(YEAR(created_at), '-W', WEEK(created_at, 1)) AS date_label, COUNT(user_id) AS signup_count FROM users WHERE created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 12 WEEK) GROUP BY date_label ORDER BY date_label ASC
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m') AS date_label, COUNT(user_id) AS signup_count FROM users WHERE created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 12 MONTH) GROUP BY date_label ORDER BY date_label ASC
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y') AS date_label, COUNT(user_id) AS signup_count FROM users GROUP BY date_label ORDER BY date_label ASC
